policy: Patrol disciplines are check categories and scheduling assignments, not claims of continuously running AI processes. Every status requires a dated source-bound receipt. Read-only checks must never mutate funds.

disciplines.label: SOURCE SENTINEL
disciplines.evidence: Git diff, import closure, ownership and route census

disciplines.label: SECURITY WARDEN
disciplines.evidence: Authorization traces, dependency scans and negative tests

disciplines.label: TREASURY GUARD
disciplines.evidence: Conservation, owner authority and live-settlement holds

disciplines.label: BROWSER SCOUT
disciplines.evidence: Semantic Ready, runtime errors and browser interaction

disciplines.label: RELEASE GUARDIAN
disciplines.evidence: Build lineage, CI, protected activation, rollback
